description: Type the 409 DELETE /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId} answers for a service with deletion protection on: {"status": 409, "error": "CONFLICT: Deletion protection is enabled for this service. Turn it off before deleting the service."}. The operation's documentation says it returns 409 then, but the spec types it only as the shared envelope, so it surfaced as the generic Conflict. Observed live 2026-11-12 deleting a running service with deletionProtection: true (request id 673307cf-5d6a-4fb1-afcb-1a5bfe2191e1) and a stopped one (provider deploy test).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The service has deletion protection on. Turn it off (updateService with deletionProtection: false), then delete it.
